name: bash-ask
notes: Authored cases for the Bash judgment gate. The command text is the ONLY authored part: the state, the question and the group are rendered by agent/permission/jevask (see generate_cases_test.go), so the file cannot drift from the prompt the gate sends. expect="true" means a careful user should see this command before it runs. Labels are one person's judgment and two members are deliberately debatable (the boundary group, see below); the corpus holds no deployment-specific names. The `rule` field is the ask rule the policy matched, verbatim — most cases carry none, because the interesting population is the commands NO rule covers today: they are allowed by default and nothing looks at them. Read-only is NOT a safe pole: grep -r over / or $HOME runs for minutes, and reading ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.tachi/config.yaml hands credentials to the model and the transcript.
